page.title: Chat attachments
page.description: Browse and manage uploaded chat attachments (upload folder only).
page.notice_protected: Files marked as protected are referenced by messages, queued drafts, assistant avatar/background, or active drafts, or were uploaded less than 24 hours ago. The server refuses to delete them; there is no force delete.
page.notice_draft_window: Unsent draft attachments are only visible to this browser: their lease lasts 24 hours. Drafts left offline or closed longer than that may lose protection—double-check before cleaning.

delete.title: Delete selected attachments
delete.description: Delete {{count}} file(s). The server re-verifies references before each deletion; still-referenced or protected items are skipped.
delete.warning: Deletion is permanent. Files referenced by messages, assistant settings, or active drafts will not be removed.

cleanup.title: Clean by age
cleanup.description: Remove attachments older than the chosen window. Every item is re-checked against the latest references (including queued messages and draft leases); protected items are skipped and failures are listed individually.
cleanup.confirm_description: This scans all upload files older than {{days}} days; protected items are skipped automatically.
cleanup.confirm_notice: Each file is re-checked during cleanup; query failures are treated as protected (fail-closed).
cleanup.truncated: At most 2000 items per run; only {{count}} processed—run again

draft.lease_failed: Draft attachment lease renewal failed; protection may expire after 24 hours
